title: Tabula Rasa: Monte Carlo estimation of unit-variance noise with controlled spatio-temporal correlation
description:
arXiv:2610.11653v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We suggest a method to generate time-varying Gaussian noise with controlled variance and controlled temporal correlation. This noise is used in several downstream tasks for temporal control and temporal coherence. The core technical idea is to phrase this problem as joint Monte-Carlo estimation of both a classic pixel reconstruction and estimation of variance using the concept of "sketching" from the database literature. We demonstrate that our method allows temporal control for downstream tasks with simpler and faster code than previous methods.
